prerequisites: Knowledge from lectures Control Engineering I, Measurement Technology I

learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to apply measurement and control engineering knowledge in laboratory experiments and to evaluate and document the experiments accordingly.
Students are able to conduct experiments in a group with a division of labor, planning and coordinating the necessary work steps together.

assessment_methods.method: Independent execution of experiments and presentation of results in the form of experiment reports and protocols

assessment_rules: The course grade is based on the independent execution of experiments and the presentation of results in the form of experiment reports and protocols, accounting for 100% of the module grade.
